description: Takes one earlier version of one of the signed-in person's specs off Spekkr: its page and its files. The spec stays listed, and its other versions stay as they are. The version's number stays used. The newest version cannot be taken off this way: unpublish_spec takes the whole spec down. This tool needs sign-in. Ask the person before you call it.

version.description: The version to take off, like 1.3.0. Not the newest.

name: unpublish_spec_version
title: Take one version down
